nota: Prompts en inglés para Petra. Cada 'prompt' ya está completo: estilo_base + especie + disfraz + acabado + evitar. Adjuntar SIEMPRE la imagen de 'referencia' (docs/brumitos/referencia/brumito.png) para la forma de pera, la cara y el fieltro; la referencia no trae antenitas ni copete de humo: el prompt los agrega. Versión 3 (#117): fieltro de lana en lugar de terciopelo, imagen de referencia; v2: antenitas de caracol, una sola pera, fondo plano.
estilo_base: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a small handmade collectible creature figure, like a premium needle-felted wool toy. Soft macro photography, shallow depth of field, soft diffused key light from the upper left, gentle rim light, realistic soft felted wool texture with fine fibers. Square 1:1 image. The creature is centered, full body visible, turned three-quarters toward the camera, filling about 70% of the image height. Perfectly flat, uniform warm light-gray background (#ECE8E4), the same color from edge to edge, no gradient, no vignette, with only a soft contact shadow under the feet. Cute, friendly and gentle, never scary.
especie: The creature is a Brumito. Its head and body are ONE continuous pear shape with no neck and no separate head: narrow and rounded at the top, widening smoothly to a broad round bottom, like a soft pear or a water drop sitting on the ground, covered in soft pastel felted wool. A small tuft of wispy, slightly translucent pastel smoke curls upward from the top of its head like a little cowlick. On top of the head it has two thin, soft, flexible antennae like a snail's eye stalks, slightly curved, about as long as one eye is wide, each ending in a small round bobble; they are thin stalks, never pointed ears and never cone-shaped horns. Two large round glossy dark eyes, each with a bright star-shaped sparkle reflection; a small happy smile showing exactly two small rounded front teeth, like a bunny; tiny stubby arms with mitten-like hands without fingers; two short round feet. It wears a Halloween costume in strong saturated colors that contrast with its pastel body.
evitar: It must not resemble Labubu or any designer vinyl toy: no long rabbit ears, no pointed ears, no cat ears, no cone-shaped horns, no row of pointy or jagged teeth, no mischievous grin. It must not resemble any Monsters, Inc. character: not one-eyed, not a green ball, no blue fur with purple spots, no big horns. Not a real animal and not a human. No blood, no fangs, no angry face. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no frame, no border, no stars overlay, no watermark.

acabado.comun: The costume is soft matte fabric.
acabado.rara: The costume details have a subtle pearlescent, iridescent sheen, as if painted with pearl.
acabado.ultra: The costume details are polished gold with warm metallic reflections, and the felted wool body has a faint pearlescent shimmer.
